yt_description:
Ever wondered how to sort data while also giving it a little cocktail shake? 🍸 Meet Cocktail Sort! 

In this mind-bending visualization, we'll see how Cocktail Sort (also known as bidirectional bubble sort or shuttle sort) efficiently sorts an array by repeatedly traversing it back and forth. 

Watch as it swaps elements in both ascending and descending passes, like a bartender mixing the perfect drink! 🤯

🚀 What you'll learn:
- The mechanics of Cocktail Sort
- Its advantages and disadvantages
- How it compares to other sorting algorithms
